title: Brain-wave driven wheelchair for paralysis patients using EEG and ML
summary: VIT researchers trained brain-wave (EEG) models on data from ten people and plan hospital tests of a wheelchair that its user steers with brain signals.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: Researchers at VIT trained models on brain-wave (EEG) data from ten people and describe promising tests. The researchers hold agreements with hospitals to test and refine the system further. The wheelchair is meant to give people with paralysis more independence in moving around. No source reports a measured change in mobility or sustained use by a patient.
